limitations: Historical course data: original acquisition, authenticity and redistribution license are unconfirmed.
Catalog metadata is a static historical snapshot; item availability at each rating date is unknown.
Most reviewers have one rating; personalization and warm-user estimates have very small samples.
Course identities are pseudonyms derived from display names, not verified stable account IDs.
Demo impressions/clicks/favorites are synthetic pipeline events and never enter these experiments.

ranking_policy.normalization: min-max over the entire canonical catalog per request
ranking_policy.coefficient_source: fixed demonstration policy, chosen before test evaluation; no test tuning
ranking_policy.retrieval_pool: exact scores for the full eligible catalog; no ANN needed at 66 items
ranking_policy.score_semantics: ranking scores are relative priorities, not probabilities or predicted ratings
